summary.text: Renaud Brown is the Green Party candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 45, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Brown is a member of the Green Party of Maryland and has run for office before, including for the Baltimore City Council in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Renaud Brown ran as the Green Party candidate for Maryland House of Delegates District 43A in the November 8, 2022 general election, receiving 4.1 percent of the vote in a race won by two Democratic incumbents.
In 2024, Brown was the Green Party candidate for Baltimore City Council District 14, and incumbent Odette Ramos defeated Brown in the November 5, 2024 general election, 90.8 percent to 8.8 percent.
Brown is running in 2026 for District 45 in the House of Delegates, where three seats are on the ballot.
